title: Choir of One Auto Rifle Guide
summary: Exotic Special Ammo Void Auto Rifle from Encore exotic mission.
content: Choir of One is an Exotic Void Auto Rifle that uses Special Ammo. Fires heavy high-impact hip-fire projectile spreads like a wyvern, and precision 5-round bursts when aiming down sights. Catalyst gives Subsistence, Destabilizing Rounds, or Onslaught.

title: Destiny 2 Update 9.7.0: Monument of Triumph & Sol System Distortions
summary: Major milestone update introducing the Tower Monument of Triumph, dynamic planetary Distortions, and the return of SRL.
content:
DESTINY 2 UPDATE 9.7.0 // MONUMENT OF TRIUMPH OVERVIEW:

1. THE MONUMENT OF TRIUMPH (TOWER COURTYARD):
- A new permanent monolith structure built at the heart of the Tower courtyard.
- Completing a game-wide matrix of Triumphs earns 'Legendary Marks'.
- Four Guardian Tenet vendors now trade Legendary Marks for free armor ornaments, legacy cosmetic packages, weapon engrams, and historical trophies.
- Power caps are left un-reset, removing seasonal power grinding and FOMO.

2. SOL SYSTEM DISTORTIONS:
- Dynamic, hourly rotating modifiers active across planetary destinations (visible on the Director screen).
- Distortions bring tougher combatants with unique visual energy auras, hostile environmental hazards, and tier-elevated gear drops upon clearing Public Events and destination objectives.

3. SPARROW RACING LEAGUE (SRL) RETURNS:
- SRL returns as a permanent ritual activity with all 4 classic tracks overhauled for modern vehicle physics, custom racing gear rewards, and dedicated time-trial bounties.

4. SYSTEMS & QUALITY OF LIFE:
- Vault storage capacity expanded across all accounts.
- Expanded in-game Loadout slots to accommodate multi-subclass and Prismatic loadout permutations.
- Scoring simplifications rolled out across Fireteam Ops, Pinnacle Ops, and Arena Ops.

title: Update 9.7.0: Exotic Weapon Catalyst Expansion (26 New Catalysts)
summary: Every remaining Exotic weapon without a catalyst received one in Update 9.7.0 (26 new catalysts + 9 reworks).
content:
DESTINY 2 UPDATE 9.7.0 // EXOTIC CATALYST EXPANSION:

1. 26 NEW CATALYSTS INTRODUCED:
- Every remaining Exotic weapon in Destiny 2 that previously lacked a catalyst officially received one.
- Raid & Dungeon Exotics: Catalysts drop directly from their respective final bosses upon completion:
  * Wish-Ender: Dropped from Dul Incaru in the Shattered Throne.
  * Collective Obligation: Dropped from Rhulk in Vow of the Disciple.
  * Other raid/dungeon Exotics follow the same guaranteed boss drop rules.
- Playlist & Ritual Exotics: Dropped from Vanguard Ops, Nightfalls, Crucible, Gambit, and the Seasonal Hub.

2. 9 CATALYST REWORKS:
- 9 older 'stat-only' catalysts (which previously only granted flat stability or reload speed) were overhauled with active gameplay perks, intrinsic subclass verbs (Scorch, Jolt, Volatile, Unravel, Slow), and enhanced kinetic ammunition loops.

3. CATALYST PROGRESSION & BUG FIXES:
- Fixed an issue where the Wish-Ender catalyst dropped incorrectly on non-dungeon activities.
- Resolved perk activation and progression tracking bugs with Collective Obligation and Exotic catalyst quest trackers.

title: Update 9.7.0: Pantheon 2.0 Boss Gauntlet & Raid Updates
summary: The return of the Pantheon boss gauntlet, encounter rotations, and critical raid/dungeon bug fixes.
content:
DESTINY 2 UPDATE 9.7.0 // PANTHEON 2.0 & ENDGAME ENCOUNTERS:

1. PANTHEON 2.0:
- Accessible directly via the revamped Raids & Dungeons node in the Director.
- Multi-boss sequential gauntlets featuring legendary encounters including Calus Resplendent, Morgeth Surpassing, and enhanced boss rotations.
- Special modifiers and weekly challenge feats (such as 'Battalions') that challenge fireteam positioning, DPS rotations, and survivability.

2. ENCOUNTER BUG FIXES & HOTFIX 9.7.0.1:
- Fixed soft-locks in Pantheon where Calus Resplendent occasionally granted clemency instead of banishing fireteams to the shadow realm.
- Fixed an issue where the Consecrated Mind would fail to spawn enemy waves when the 'Battalions' feat was active.
- Master Conquest: Conductor's Keep spawn point bug resolved and the activity safely re-enabled.

3. DUNGEON PERK & SET BONUS TUNING:
- Shattered Throne 4-Piece Set Bonus ('Truth to Power'): Fixed a critical bug where the set bonus was erroneously increasing incoming damage to Guardians rather than mitigating it. It now properly applies intended defensive damage reductions.

title: Update 9.7.0: Weapons, Armor & Exotic Tuning (Hazardous Propulsion, Destination Refresh)
summary: Full destination gear refresh, Hazardous Propulsion bug fix, Exotic mod energy restorations, and weapon perk corrections.
content:
DESTINY 2 UPDATE 9.7.0 // WEAPONS, ARMOR & SANDBOX TUNING:

1. DESTINATION GEAR REFRESH:
- All legacy destinations prior to The Edge of Fate received an end-to-end loot refresh:
  * Weapons feature modern, updated perk pools, tiered legendary stats, and destination-specific origin traits.
  * Destination armor sets updated with active set bonuses that synergize with planetary activities and Distortions.

2. EXOTIC ARMOR BALANCING & ENERGY FIX:
- Hazardous Propulsion (Titan Exotic Chest): Fixed an issue where Exodus Rockets would fail to fire more than once per life when utilizing Rally Barricade without the Shieldburst aspect equipped. Rockets now fire reliably on every valid cooldown.
- Exotic Mod Energy Restoration: Fixed an issue where post-The Edge of Fate Exotics obtained prior to Update 9.7.0 had less Armor Mod energy available than intended. All affected pieces now have full energy allocations.

3. WEAPON TRAIT & PERK CORRECTIONS:
- Zephyr (Dawning Stasis Sword): Fixed a bug where right-column traits erroneously generated in the left column. Existing rolls were updated in-place with the proper left-column perk pool.
- Competitive Playlist: Replaced seasonal weapon-only drops with a unified 'Competitive Gear' pool granting armor sets, focusable weapon engrams, and unique playlist milestone emblems.

title: Hierarchy of Needs Catalyst
content:
How to Get the Catalyst
• Activity: Clear the final boss of Spire of the Watcher on Master difficulty.

• Checkpoint: You do not need a full dungeon run; a Master boss checkpoint works.

• Requirements: You must already own the Hierarchy of Needs exotic bow and have access to the dungeon via the Witch Queen dungeon key.

Catalyst Perks and Upgrades
• Perk Name: Panoptic Tessellation (Emergency Scramble)

• Buff Effect: Deployed Guidance Rings or hits with seeking projectiles grant a 5-second buff:
	• 50% decreased Draw Time
	• 40% reduced Hip-Fire Accuracy Cone
	• 100 Reload Speed
	• Faster reload animation duration

• Masterwork Completion: Defeat 700 enemies with the weapon to fully activate the catalyst. (Fast catalyst farming spots like the Shuro Chi checkpoint in Last Wish or Grasp of Avarice help speed this up.)

title: Verified Build: Solar Hunter Blade Barrage Boss DPS (Shards of Galanor)
summary: Personally tested and optimized Solar Hunter blueprint for Dungeon / Raid (Boss DPS).
content:
VERIFIED VANGUARD CLAN BUILD // SOLAR HUNTER BLADE BARRAGE BOSS DPS (SHARDS OF GALANOR)

? Guardian Class: Hunter
? Subclass: Solar
? Target Activity: Dungeon / Raid
? Tactical Inquiry Focus: Boss DPS

? SUPER & ABILITIES:
- Super: Blade Barrage
- Class Ability: Acrobat's Dodge
- Melee: User's choice (Knife Trick or Weighted Knife)
- Grenade: User's choice (Healing Grenade or Fusion Grenade)
- Aspects: Knock 'Em Down, Crackshot
- Fragments: Ember of Benevolence, Ember of Empyrean, Ember of Singeing, Ember of Ashes

? RECOMMENDED ARSENAL:
- Kinetic: User's choice (Sniper or Kinetic Tremors scout recommended)
- Energy: User's choice (Solar primary/fusion recommended)
- Heavy: One Thousand Voices (Recommended if unlocked; Apex Predator or Dragon's Breath are alternatives, just not as good)

? ARTIFACT & PERKS:
- Artifact: Tablet of Ruin
- Key Perks: Limit Break, Elemental Supercharger, Particle Reconstruction (for One Thousand Voices to apply weakening)

? ARMOR SET & EXOTIC PIECE:
- Armor Set: Lustrous Casque Set (Tower Kiosk / Solstice Armor Engrams)
- Set Bonus: 4-Piece Set Bonus: Heals on Solar weapon final blows.
- Exotic Armor: Shards of Galanor (Gauntlets)
  * Description: Throwing Knife final blows decrease the cooldown of your Super. Hitting a single target with most Blade Barrage knives in a volley causes them to release a violent Solar explosion, releasing scorching Solar shrapnel. Hits and final blows with Blade Barrage return Super energy after the Super ends.
  * Community Insight:
• Throwing Knife Kills grant 2.5–5% Super Energy depending on enemy rank.
• Passively increases Blade Barrage impact and explosive damage by 25%.
• Landing 5 Blade Barrage knives triggers a Solar Detonation (up to 2 per cast).
• Each Detonation deals significant damage across a 10m radius with no falloff and releases 4 Scorching Shrapnel applying 20 Scorch each (unaffected by Ember of Ashes).
• Detonations & shrapnel deal ~35% reduced damage to Boss-Tier combatants and are not buffed by Super Stat.
• Blade Barrage hits and kills refund up to a maximum of 50% Super energy.
• Overall increase to Blade Barrage damage against Boss combatants is roughly ~140%!

? RECOMMENDED ARMOR MODS:
- Helmet: 2x Dynamo, 1x Harmonic Siphon
- Arms/Gloves: Dexterity Mod (matching weapon choice), 1x Harmonic Loader
- Chest: User's choice (Damage Resistance / Reserves)
- Legs/Boots: 2x Solar Weapon Surge, 1x Holster Mod (user's choice)
- Class Item: Powerful Attraction, Distribution, Reaper

? STAT PRIORITIES & GHOST MOD:
- Stats: 150+ Weapon & Super stat (200 is best), at least 100 Class stat, 0 Health, low Melee and Grenade (not a key part of the build).
- Recommended Ghost Mod: Powerhouse (Recommended to get close to target stat splits)

title: Verified Build: Arc Warlock Chaos Reach Infinite Super & Ad Clear (Geomag Stabilizers)

content:

? Guardian Class: Warlock
? Subclass: Arc
? Target Activity: Dungeon / Raid
? Tactical Inquiry Focus: Boss DPS, Soft Ad Clear

? SUPER & ABILITIES:
- Super: Chaos Reach
- Class Ability: Healing Rift
- Melee: Chain Lightning
- Grenade: User's choice (Pulse or Storm Grenade recommended)
- Aspects: Arc Soul, Electrostatic Mind
- Fragments: Spark of Resistance, Spark of Frequency, Spark of Discharge, Spark of Shock

? RECOMMENDED ARSENAL:
- Kinetic: User's choice (Primary weapon of choice)
- Energy: Arc weapon with Jolting Feedback & Voltshot (e.g. Chrysura Melo from 'The Shattered Throne' dungeon - easiest dungeon in the game)
- Heavy: One Thousand Voices or Thunderlord (Thunderlord is very easy to get and still very, very good)

? ARTIFACT & PERKS:
- Artifact: Tablet of Ruin (especially if using 1K or fusion alongside)
- Key Perks: Dielectric, Flashover, Photonic Flare, Limit Break, Defibrillating Blast

? ARMOR SET & EXOTIC PIECE:
- Armor Set: Luminopotent Set (Fireteam Ops or focus from Zavala)
- Set Bonus: 4-Piece Set Bonus: 'Shock and Clear' — Final blows with Jolt or against Jolted combatants create Ionic Traces which fund your Super.
- Exotic Armor: Geomag Stabilizers (Boots)
  * Description: Damaging targets with Chaos Reach extends its duration. Collecting Ionic Traces grants you energy for Chaos Reach. Sprinting while near max Bolt Charge will grant stacks over time.
  * Community Insight:
• Collecting Ionic Traces grants 4% Chaos Reach Super Energy.
• While at 5 Stacks of Bolt Charge or higher, after sprinting for at least 1.5 seconds, maintaining sprint grants a Stack of Bolt Charge every 0.33 seconds.
• Chaos Reach refunds 10% Super Energy on hit (0.75s cooldown between refunds).
• This can increase Chaos Reach beam duration by up to ~120%!

? RECOMMENDED ARMOR MODS:
- Helmet: 1x Harmonic Siphon, 2x Font of Wisdom (Super Fonts)
- Arms/Gloves: 2x Font of Discipline (Grenade Fonts), 1x Bolstering Detonation
- Chest: User's choice (Reserves / Resistances)
- Legs/Boots: 1x Arc Weapon Surge, 1x Better Already, 1x Recuperation
- Class Item: 1x Reaper, 1x Powerful Attraction, 1x Time Dilation

? STAT PRIORITIES & GHOST MOD:
- Stats: 150+ Grenade and Super stats, 50+ Class and Weapons, 0 Health and Melee are not really used (unless you find yourself doing more melee than grenades).
- Recommended Ghost Mod: Grenadier, Powerhouse, or Demolitionist (Recommended for these stats)

? Guardian Class: Titan
? Subclass: Stasis

- Super: Glacial Quake

- Key Perks: Crystalline Converter, Wind Chill, Frost Renewal, Curative Orbs, Hail the Storm, The Thick of It, Brain Freeze

? ARMOR SET & EXOTIC PIECE:
- Armor Set: Seventh Seraph Set (Cosmodrome Public Events / Master Lost Sectors for easy T5) OR Exodus Down Set (Nessus Public Events / Master Lost Sectors for easy T5)
- Set Bonus: High Tier-5 armor set providing maximum stat allocation and resilience thresholds.
- Exotic Armor: Icefall Mantle (Gauntlets)
  * Description: While you have a Stasis Super equipped, rapid Stasis final blows grant Frost Armor. You heal a small amount whenever you gain Frost Armor. Replaces your class ability with a burst of Stasis energy that freezes nearby combatants, slows nearby opponents, and grants you increased Frost Armor.
  * Community Insight:
• Requires a Stasis Super Ability to be equipped.
• Overwrites Barricade Cooldown to a unique, faster 70-second base cooldown (~30 seconds at 100 Class Stat).
• Scoring 2 Stasis Kills within 3 seconds of each grants a Stack of Frost Armor.
• Restores 10 HP for each Stack of Frost Armor you gain from any source.
• Replaces Barricade with Glacial Guard (does not work with Thruster).
• On Glacial Guard Cast: Grants maximum Frost Armor Stacks (restoring HP for each stack gained) and applies 100 Slow (40 in PVP) to nearby combatants.

? RECOMMENDED ARMOR MODS:
- Helmet: 2x Hands-On, 1x Harmonic Siphon
- Arms/Gloves: 1x Impact Induction, 1x Grenade Kickstart, 1x Heavy Handed
- Chest: User's choice (Elemental Resists)
- Legs/Boots: 2x Invigoration, 1x Solar Weapon Surge (or Kinetic Surge if using Fighting Lion)
- Class Item: 1x Reaper, 1x Powerful Attraction, 1x Time Dilation

? STAT PRIORITIES & GHOST MOD:
- Stats: 100+ Weapon, Super, and Melee stat. Health, Grenade, and Class are user's choice (those stats don't really matter for this loop).
- Recommended Ghost Mod: Skirmisher, Powerhouse, or Paragon (Recommended for achieving these stats)
